subject.title: dotenv loader does not expand env references in .env files

question: Should OpenClaw support `$VAR` and `${VAR}` expansion in trusted/global dotenv loading, and if so should the same expansion apply only after the workspace `.env` security blocklist filters untrusted keys?
rationale: The source issue is real, but expanding dotenv values changes credential interpretation and overlaps with existing SecretRef/config-substitution guidance, so automation should not choose the permanent env contract alone.

options.title: Approve narrow trusted expansion
options.body: Implement expansion in the shared dotenv loader after existing precedence and workspace blocklist rules, with docs and regression tests for literal-dollar secrets and unresolved references.

options.title: Reject dotenv expansion
options.body: Keep dotenv values literal and document that users should use process env, config `${VAR}` substitution, or SecretRef-supported credential fields instead.

options.title: Defer to broader secret UX work
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until the env.vars SecretRef and first-class environment-backed secret direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow trusted expansion
recommendation.body: Implement expansion in the shared dotenv loader after existing precedence and workspace blocklist rules, with docs and regression tests for literal-dollar secrets and unresolved references.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the most recent current-main ownership signal on the dotenv/config env files and the latest release commit carrying the behavior.
